note: Hard-mode dynasty options (roadmap item 20; core/game/game_hard_mode.gd, checked by tools/check_data.gd). Three options a player may switch on when founding a dynasty, kept on the dynasty as `hard` (a key is saved only for an option that is on, so an ordinary save is what it always was). They are set once, at the founding: none can be switched on for a house that has already lived, and none can be switched off. `permadeath`: an heir who dies of one of `permadeath_causes` ends the saga instead of passing the name on. `ironman`: the house cannot be copied or exported as a backup, a backup of such a house is not read back in, nothing is restored over its slot, and the save before the last is not kept. `gen_cap`: the saga ends with the heir of that generation (one of `gen_caps`), instead of ages.json's `max_generations`. No dice. The autopilot plays under whatever the dynasty was founded with.

permadeath.name: Whole-line permadeath
permadeath.about: If an heir is slain in battle the dynasty ends with them: no child takes up the name. An heir who dies of old age or sickness still passes it on.
permadeath.active: Whole-line permadeath: the house ends with the first heir slain in battle.

ironman.name: Iron-man save
ironman.about: One save and no going back: the house cannot be copied or exported as a backup, no backup can be restored over it, and the save before the last is not kept. A save file damaged on the device cannot be recovered.
ironman.active: Iron-man save: no backups, and no save to go back to.

gen_cap.name: Generation cap
gen_cap.about: The saga ends when the heir of the chosen generation dies, however they die.
gen_cap.active: Generation cap: the saga ends with the heir of generation {cap}.

text.panel_note: These are chosen once, when the dynasty is founded. They cannot be switched on for a house that already lives, and they can never be switched off.
text.too_late: Hard-mode options are chosen at the founding. They cannot be switched on for a house that already lives.
